title: Score After Flipping Matrix
summary: Given an m x n binary matrix, determine the maximum score by flipping any number of rows or columns.
statement: Given an m x n binary matrix, determine the maximum score by flipping any number of rows or columns. The score is the sum of binary numbers formed by each row after flipping.
constraints: Flip any rows or columns of a binary matrix.
Interpret each row as binary and maximize their sum.
hints: The most significant bit dominates every lower bit, so every row should first be made to lead with one.
Treat row flips implicitly, then choose the majority normalized bit per later column.
Score leading column as all ones; for c count grid[r][c]==grid[r][0] and take max(count,rows-count).
Column choices are independent after optimal row normalization, and binary weights convert counts directly to score.
editorial: Column choices are independent after optimal row normalization, and binary weights convert counts directly to score.

tests.explanation: Making every leading bit one and choosing each later majority gives total 39.
Flipping the only bit gives score one.
